name: Forex Signal Outcome
description: One row per emitted forex signal, written at emission time and settled exactly once with what actually happened (win / loss / scratch / expired). The outcome ledger behind the human-triggered retraining loop — evidence only, nothing consumes these rows automatically. Admin-only, never sent to clients. Verdicts are append-once: the controller refuses any edit to a settled outcome. All datetimes are UTC.

fields.label: Strategy
fields.description: The strategy's catalog identifier (Forex Strategy strategy_key).

fields.label: Strategy Version Checksum
fields.description: The pinned Forex Strategy Version's spec_checksum — the immutable identity of the parameter set that emitted this signal. Reports group by this, never across it.

fields.label: Risk Preset
fields.description: Label only — the enforced numbers live in the user's Forex Risk Profile (resolved parameters, not this name).

fields.label: Outcome
fields.description: Empty until settled. win = target reached; loss = stop reached; scratch = closed flat-ish; expired = never triggered / timed out. Written once — settled rows refuse edits.

fields.label: Pips
fields.description: Signed result in pips, after spread. Negative for a loss, 0 for a scratch or an expiry.
